import awkward as ak

class DimuonAnalysis(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis workflow"""
    
    def process_objects(self, events, **kwargs):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = events.Muon
        good_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = muons[good_mask]
        return events
    
    def count_objects(self, events, **kwargs):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events

from pocket_coffea.workflows.base import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak

class DimuonAnalysis(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis workflow"""
    
    def process_objects(self, events, **kwargs):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = events.Muon
        good_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = muons[good_mask]
        return events
    
    def count_objects(self, events, **kwargs):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events
